summary: After the first message, Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village says the Wildhammer and their gryphons are as close as a troll and a mate. Disgusting, but it can be used against them. Otho wants gryphons in the Hinterlands killed for their feathers.

sections.title: A Message of Feathers
sections.body: After the Highvale high elves, Otho Moji'ko has another message to send. The Wildhammer and their gryphons are said to be as close as a troll and a mate, which Otho finds disgusting, but useful. Kill the gryphons you meet across the Hinterlands and collect their Long Elegant Feathers. Gryphons are known to live in every region there. From the feathers, Otho will make the final message.

sections.title: Otho's Pleasure
sections.body: Otho expects the last message to scare the Wildhammer off, or else to make them very, very angry. Otho is delighted that one more step remains before the Wildhammer see that trolls cannot be crossed.

aliases: who gives another message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: Otho Moji'ko, who stands in Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Why does Otho Moji'ko want gryphon feathers?
faq.answer: Otho says the Wildhammer and their gryphons are as close as a troll and a mate, and wants to use that against them. The feathers will go into the final message.
Gryphons are known to live in every region of the Hinterlands.

aliases: what comes before another message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: It follows Message to the Wildhammer, in which Otho had Highvale high elves slaughtered as a warning to the dwarves.
